objective: Proof: every stage of round 1 or later under complete rounds satisfies the parent rule (P1) and keeps its junctions with loose distinctions apart (P2).
status: Proved 2026-11-19 (referee pending; census last shard pending): Theorems 1-3: complete rounds from a connected start keep backed pairs by a closed junction and live junctions apart at every stage of round >= 1, peel back exactly (depth >= round), and never lengthen a previous-stage bond distance; checked on 70,228 census stages with no violation.
title: The parent rule holds at every reached stage
